fact: NIPAM signed an MoU on 4 June 2026 with the Global Cybersecurity Centre to jointly develop and deliver cybersecurity training for Namibian public servants, per TechAfrica News.

NIPAM announced at an AI executive leadership seminar in Windhoek structured three- to five-day AI courses for civil servants, starting with executive directors and senior management, with the curriculum being finalised, per The Namibian.
